### Column Legends

| Column | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **ID** | `BL-##` | Stable identifier. Does not change when rank changes. |
| **Rank** | `1`, `2`, `3`, ... | Delivery order. Lower is higher priority. |
| **Work item** | Text | Short description of requirement, feature, defect, or task. |
| **Priority** | `Must`, `Should`, `Could`, `Won't` | MoSCoW priority. |
| **Effort** | `XS`, `S`, `M`, `L`, `XL` | Relative size estimate. |
| **Status** | `Proposed`, `Not started`, `Ready`, `In progress`, `Blocked`, `Done` | Current workflow state. |
| **Related IDs** | Register IDs | Linked risks, issues, actions, decisions, changes, or dependencies. |
| **Source** | Path or reference | Location of the source evidence. |
| **Verified** | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Date the row was last checked against its source. |
